summary: Toro Corp. filed a Form 6-K on May 28, 2026, attaching a press release reporting its financial results for the three months ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a routine earnings report covering total vessel revenues of $6.0 million, net income of $0.5 million, and cash of $81.6 million. It notes a previous special dividend declared on December 5, 2025, and a new revolving credit facility entered on March 30, 2026. No special situation is present; this is an ordinary financial update for a foreign private issuer.
